source_anchor: 某企业Agent落地方法论六步链路：选准任务→说清任务→装备能力→稳定运行→业务价值→沉淀复用。第六步沉淀复用产生八大资产类型，形成飞轮效应
reader_takeaway: 企业Agent落地是一个六步链路，终点是资产沉淀形成飞轮

intent.audience: 企业决策者、AI落地方向负责人
intent.feeling: 路径清晰、终点明确——不是一次性项目而是飞轮
intent.author_stance: 该方法论强调落地的系统性和资产化思维
intent.one_sentence: 六步链路从选场景到资产沉淀，飞轮效应是最终价值

truth_constraints: 六步顺序必须从左到右
最后一步必须有飞轮回流到第一步的视觉表现

relationship.direction: left-to-right pipeline, then loop back from step 6 to step 1
relationship.focal_module: 第六步'沉淀复用'（飞轮起点）

core_action: bridge（桥接：在第六步和第一步之间架设飞轮回路）

worker_decision.what_breaks_if_removed: 没有人架设飞轮回路，六步就变成一次性项目而非持续循环
worker_decision.worker_family: Router / 走线工 (acting as bridge builder)
worker_decision.worker_tool: solder bridge + copper carrier trace forming the loop

metaphor_world: server rack with stacked boards, each board = one step

state_coding.focal_accent: Growth Cyan on step 6 and flywheel trace

final_prompt: Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal article illustration in the Circuit Workers style. A miniature PCB diorama seen from a high angle. The scene shows a six-stage pipeline on a green circuit board. From left to right: six raised chips connected by a copper bus bar. Chips 1-5 have lit green LEDs. Chip 6 labeled '沉淀复用' has a flashing cyan LED (the focal point — this is where assets accumulate). A copper carrier trace loops back from chip 6 to chip 1, glowing cyan, labeled '飞轮' — this is the flywheel return path. A small soldering-cap robot worker (round silver head, green PCB body, tiny arms) is physically building a solder bridge between chip 6 and the return trace — it holds a solder bridge tool, completing the loop. The worker's LED has one cyan dot (growth state). Chip labels from left to right: '选任务', '说清楚', '装备', '稳定运行', '业务价值', '沉淀复用'. The board has 3D depth: raised chips, gold-copper traces, silver solder joints, green solder mask. The cyan flywheel loop is visually prominent, curving from right side back to left. Labels are readable Chinese silkscreen prints. Palette: PCB green, copper gold, solder silver, power green (steps 1-5), growth cyan (step 6 + flywheel focal). No flat schematic, no stock icons, no fake dense text, no cartoon eyes. Editorial, tactile, publish-grade.
qa_risks: worker可能不在第六步执行桥接动作
